scope: Diagnostic/descriptive only; no full-mix logistic inference, no replacement attack timestamps, no PLP evaluation planned. Previously PLP-exposed investigator; process isolated.
windows: Reuse exact per-query search_start/end from frozen historical candidates; contained and unchanged. STFT context identical to frozen generator (150ms outside for feature support only), but full-mix candidates retained strictly inside frozen query window.
representation: Identical Hann1024/hop44,44100Hz,positive magnitude flux30<=f<250 and native frame centers, stereo arithmetic mean. No stem candidate regeneration. Full-mix peak enumeration reuses frozen morphology code; no learned decision applied.
salience_flag: Diagnostic display/classification aid only: prominence > median(window prominences)+3*MAD(window prominences), AND existing low_energy_post_pre_logratio>0 AND rms_post_pre_logratio>0. Unscaled MAD. No outcome tuning. All unflagged peaks retained. This is not a validated physical attack detector or a changed frozen selector threshold.
coordinate_relation: At each stem candidate: count salient full-mix peaks within half Hann support (512/44100 s). Multiple→FULLMIX_MULTIPLE_PLAUSIBLE_FRONTS; single within one hop→FULLMIX_CORRESPONDING_FRONT; single farther→FULLMIX_NEARBY_DISTINCT_FRONT; none→NO_CLEAR_FULLMIX_FRONT. Also preserve nearest raw full-mix peak and its qualification separately. These are resolution-linked descriptive correspondences, not source proof.
episode_aggregation: Union candidate RECORDS from separate member windows by exact native PCM coordinate only; no search-window bridging. One salient coordinate→clear local-front cue; more than one→multiple; zero→no clear cue. Every independent query window remains separate.
selected17: For each previous selected episode use salient full-mix coordinates across its exact routed windows. One within one hop of stem→supports stem selection; one earlier/later→different earlier/later; multiple→ambiguous; none→no support. Support means full-mix acoustic cue only, not Bass identification.
late_cohort: Selected stem minus any successful native BP query onset >one Hann support(1024/44100s), plus PI-namedHF044/HF047 explicitly regardless. No timestamp replacement.
limits: Other instruments can dominate full-mix low-band transients. Cue absence does not establish no physical attack. Domain comparisons descriptive, model coefficient contributions associative; no causal latency inference.
